title: BiDashboardTemplate
description: 1.46.0: a slot structure shipped as pack content (packs/nexus-base/dashboards/*.json) — P0: executive_overview · operational_control · performance_vs_target · risk_exceptions. A template instantiates into an ordinary draft; there is no template runtime.

metric_key.description: 1.53.0: the exact metric key this slot wants — the planner takes the Project's validated/certified metric of that key before any hint (NEXUS platform templates bind to the product-metrics keys); absent → `missing_metric · metric_key_absent`.

series_by.description: 1.54.0: for a `chart` slot — the dataset column whose values become the chart's series (one line per value, ≤ 6; e.g. `arm` for a benchmark by retrieval arm). Absent: one series over time. A hint for whoever fills the slot (the person in *From data*, or `scripts/product-metrics.py` as the person); the planner leaves chart slots open — a chart is a Canvas artifact, never made by bi-api.

deployment_targets.description: 1.53.0: the deployment targets this template is offered on; absent or empty = every target. `nexus_infrastructure` names on_prem · disconnected — an enterprise deployment controls its own NEXUS, a cloud tenant does not.

platform.description: 1.53.0: true for the NEXUS platform templates (quality · usage · infrastructure · graph · vibeban) — the Plan dialog groups them apart from the decision templates.
